# restactd

> Documentation for restactd, the reference host for REST:ACT: run sandboxed WebAssembly verbs over plain HTTP, with budgets, capabilities and run-as-caller identity.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://restact.org/docs/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for restactd, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://restact.org/docs/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for restactd

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
